subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should trusted webhook hook calls be allowed to opt into persistent reuse of an authorized stable session key while omitted mode remains isolated?
rationale: This is a new public hook/config mode that changes whether an externally initiated request can re-enter an existing agent conversation; the acceptable authorization and compatibility boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve explicit persistent mode
options.body: Adopt an opt-in persistent mode for direct hooks, mappings, and transforms while preserving isolated default behavior and existing session-key authorization checks.

options.title: Keep hooks isolated only
options.body: Retain fresh isolated hook sessions and clarify the documented limitation rather than exposing existing-session re-entry.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit persistent mode
recommendation.body: Adopt an opt-in persistent mode for direct hooks, mappings, and transforms while preserving isolated default behavior and existing session-key authorization checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available maintainer discussion already frames the intended compatibility and security tradeoff.
